name: Spiked Corridor // Torture Pit
oracle_text:
When you unlock this door, create three 1/1 red Devil creature tokens with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
(You may cast either half. That door unlocks on the battlefield. As a sorcery, you may pay the mana cost of a locked door to unlock it.)
If a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.

needs.what: Room split permanents (rule 709.5): a card with two door halves, each with its own name and mana cost, castable as either half; the cast half enters unlocked, the other locked; a locked door's abilities are inactive; a sorcery-speed special action pays a locked door's mana cost to unlock it; the permanent's name/cost reflect only unlocked doors
needs.why_existing_wont_do: second_face is a split/adventure/MDFC half that is cast instead of the front and then is the whole object; nothing keeps both halves on one permanent with per-half locked/unlocked state, and no special action unlocks a half

needs.what: a trigger event 'when you unlock this door' that fires when this door becomes unlocked, both when the half is cast (enters unlocked) and when unlocked later by the special action
needs.why_existing_wont_do: self_enters fires only on entering, missing a later unlock, and fires even when this door enters locked because the other half was cast; trigger_events has no unlock event

needs.what: a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
